title: A New Era: Head Coach Nathan Paetsch
description: We've closed one amazing chapter, and now we start the next! We welcome to the show the new head coach of the Phantoms, 17 year pro and most recently an Assistant Coach with the AHL's Rochester Americans, Nathan Paetsch!

title: Ryan Ward: The Exit Interview
description: This isn't goodbye, just goodbye for now. We welcome Ryan, Jessica, Ollie & Teddy to the show to talk about what Youngstown has meant to them, as well as Ryan's thoughts as he joins the AHL's Providence Bruins as an Assistant Coach. From all of us, to Ryan and the Ward Family, thank you!

title: 2026 Main Camp: Part 8 - Jackson Adams & Kevyn Adams
description: We've reached the end! This is Part 8 of the 2026 Main Camp Recap! So to finish off the series, we are joined by Phantoms defenseman Jackson Adams and his father, former NHL player, Sabres GM and current Boston Bruins Senior Advisor, Kevyn Adams!

title: 2026 Main Camp: Part 7 - Brandon Gotkin & Cal Kiefiuk
description: This is Part 7 of the 2026 Main Camp Recap. We're close to wrapping this year's series up, and we're closing out with some heavy hitters. Coming up in this episode is Associate Head Coach Brandon Gotkin and Assistant Coach Cal Kiefiuk!

title: 2026 Main Camp: Part 6 - Brayden Thompson, Sean Miller & Jesse Orlowsky
description: This is Part 6 of the 2026 Main Camp Recap. Coming up, we were joined by super friends Brayden Thompson and Sean Miller, followed by their relationship counselor Jesse Orlowsky. This one was a ton of fun! Enjoy!

title: 2026 Main Camp: Part 5 - Jeff Cox & Tim Parkos
description: This is Part Five of the 2026 Main Camp Recap. Coming up, we welcome back to the show, Assistant GMs Jeff Cox and Tim Parkos! We'll take a look at some of the Phantoms new Phase I picks, as well as what it's like out on the scouting trail. Enjoy!

title: 2026 Main Camp: Part 4 - Logan Anderson & Austin Hall
description: Welcome to Part Four of the 2026 Main Camp Recap. Coming up, we welcome back forward and last season's tender, Logan Anderson. We also welcome first timer Austin Hall, the Phantoms tender for the upcoming season! We're halfway home!

title: 2026 Main Camp: Part 3 - Ryan Ward & Ollie Ward
description: Welcome back to Part Three of the 2026 Main Camp Recap. We welcome Phantoms Head Coach Ryan Ward, and his handpicked special guest, his son Ollie! Buckle up, the kid doesn't hold back!

title: 2026 Main Camp: Part 2 - Kamden Kaiser, Jack Hair & Jackson Conroy
description: Up next is Part Two of the 2026 Main Camp Recap. We welcome Phase II pick Kamden Kaiser, followed by Phase I picks Jack Hair and Jackson Conroy to the show. The future is bright!

title: 2026 Main Camp: Part 1 - Brody Berard & Lukas Zajic
description: We kick off the 2026 Main Camp Recap with Phantoms defenseman Brody "One Punch" Berard, along with the newcomer, forward Lukas Zajic!

title: Season 8 Finale
description: Well, this is the end of the line. Congratulations to the Phantoms for an incredible season, and thank you to everyone who followed and helped us along this journey. Let's go out with a bang, then on to the next!

title: Round Two v2: Well... This Isn't Ideal
description: Formatting quickly took a hit in this episode, and we just ended up talking through our feelings. Pour a cold one (unless you're driving while listening, then don't do that) and kick back with us as we pick up the pieces and focus on this weekend.

title: Round Two: Idle No More
description: Phantoms hockey is back after the bye week, and so are we. We recap all the Round 1 action with returning guest Joel Norman, then turn the page and break down what to expect in Round 2.

title: Round One: Spectators Edition
description: The Phantoms capture the Anderson Cup and roll into the postseason with momentum. We break down what it means and preview Round 1 of the playoffs, plus Joel Norman returns to help us size up the Western Conference.

title: Red, White, & Run Over w/ Cal Huston & Ryan Rucinski
description: The Phantoms take care of business against the NTDP U17s in their lone game of the weekend, and we break down the win with guests Cal Huston and Ryan Rucinski, and talk about the past few years and legacy going forward.

title: Eastern Conference: Under New (Same) Management w/ Matt Lipcsak
description: The Phantoms sweep Chicago in two games to secure back-to-back Eastern Conference championships. We break down the big weekend, the standout moments, plus special guest play-by-play broadcaster Matt Lipsack joins the show.

title: Two Games, No Salvation w/ Jack Willson
description: The Phantoms take care of business with a two-game sweep over the Dubuque Fighting Saints. We break down the big weekend, key moments that made the difference, and what it means moving forward. Plus, special guest Jack Willson joins the show to talk his Phantoms legacy, the locker room, and more.

title: At Least We Didn't Get Swept w/ Jack Hextall
description: The Phantoms drop 2 of 3 over the weekend, but the vibes aren’t completely dead yet. We break down the games, dive into a robust Q&A, and welcome special guest Jack Hextall to the show. Plenty of hockey talk, a few laughs, and maybe even some optimism.

title: Dancing The Night Away w/ Evan Jardine
description: The Youngstown Phantoms take 2 of 3 on the weekend and officially punch their ticket to the dance. We break down the games and welcome special guest Evan Jardine to talk about the weekend, Dad's Weekend, and gearing up for the stretch run.

title: Call The Janitor w/ Tobias Trejbal
description: The Phantoms hit the road and leave Waterloo with a two-game sweep and zero hospitality points awarded. We break down the weekend wins and welcome guest goaltender Tobias Trejbal, fresh off making shooters reconsider their career decisions.

title: Panic! At The Arena w/ Carter Murphy
description: Three games. Three losses. Zero sugarcoating. We break down a brutal weekend, what went wrong, and how the team responds—plus special guest Carter Murphy joins the show to add some insight, perspective, and a little hope after a rough stretch.

title: Money Doesn't Buy Motivation w/ Kazumo Sasaki
description: Money is the root of all evil, and good hockey teams, apparently. We're back for another packed episode, including a sweep of the Stars and a Q&A that tested our limits. We also welcome to the show Phantoms speedster Kazumo Sasaki!

title: Winning Is Fun, Losing Still Sucks w/ Jesse Orlowsky
description: The Phantoms split the weekend—one up, one down—and we break it all down with plenty of opinions that probably shouldn’t be trusted. Plus, special guest Jesse Orlowsky jumps on to talk hockey, life, and whatever else gets accidentally brought up.

title: Chasing Butterflies w/ Matej Teply
description: The Phantoms scored 20 goals in two games, which is rude, unnecessary, and incredibly fun. We recap the weekend where the red light basically needed an ice pack, then chat with defenseman Matej Teply about life on the blue line while the forwards were treating goals like a clearance sale.

title: Timber! w/ Ryan Kosecki
description: Four games in five days, legs are tired, and somehow the Phantoms are still standing. We recap the chaos, dive into a Phan Q&A that gets a little out of hand, and welcome special guest (and co-GM) Ryan Kosecki to make sense of it all.

title: No Quarter Given w/ Joel Norman
description: Two games, two wins — the Phantoms sweep Des Moines. We recap the weekend, answer phan questions, and welcome Omaha Lancers broadcaster Joel Norman to the show. https://dcpodcast.buzzsprout.com/share

title: Back From The Break, Still Full w/ Ryan Ward
description: Holiday break is over, the rust stayed home, and the Phantoms came back collecting 7 of 8 points on the road like it was duty-free shopping. We recap the trip, overreact just the right amount, and sit down with Head Coach Ryan Ward to find out what’s actually going on behind the bench. Spoiler: winning helps.

title: 2025 Holiday Episode w/ Andrew Strathmann
description: A holiday episode built on memories and moments. Former team captain Andrew Strathmann joins the show to look back on life in the room, the pride of wearing the “C,” and the moments that still stick with him.

title: Silence of the Lamps w/ Malachi McKinnon
description: The Phantoms keep rolling with a seven-game win streak, and we’re breaking down how they’ve pulled it off. Plus, we dive into a fresh round of Phan Q&A and sit down with special guest Malachi McKinnon to talk development, locker-room vibes, and what’s next. Tune in!

title: In Lynn We Trust w/ Owen Lepak
description: It's a week to celebrate! From the Phantoms 4 game win streak to Lynn Seekford's 500th USHL game as an off-ice official, to us finally getting to sit down for an interview with Phantoms goaltender Owen Lepak! Break out the confetti!

title: Meltdown In Iowa w/ Jack Hamilton
description: We're back for another week, with a big format change to boot! The Phantoms ended their long road trip with two wins against Dubuque, and we've got defenseman Jack Hamilton to help us break it all down!

title: This One's For Us w/ John & Brie Tomko
description: We had to make a decision this week. Cover the Phantoms weekend in Fargo, or talk to two of our favorite Covelli Centre family members. So in this episode, we welcome John & Brie Tomko to the show for an extended sit down!

title: Mmmm, Donuts w/ Cooper Simpson
description: The Phantoms are riding a 3 game winning streak after dismantling Sioux Falls at Covelli this past weekend. In this episode, we've got recaps, holiday cheer-ish, Q&A galore, and we welcome Phantoms forward Cooper Simpson to the show!

title: Shots, (No) Shots, Shots w/ Cal Kiefiuk
description: Refreshed and rested, we're back with another episode this week! We look back at an interesting Chicago series at Covelli, and mix it up in Phan Q&A. We also welcome new Assistant Coach and Director of Player Development Cal Kiefiuk!

title: Punching Up w/ Owen Boucher
description: The Phantoms won 2 of 3 in their first 3 game weekend of the season! They even got a few extra minutes of play without needing overtime. We'll look back at how it all went down, and we welcome forward Owen Boucher to the show!

title: Getting Back On Track w/ JT Veney
description: The Phantoms split their home opening weekend, and some of us were there for some of it! We'll look back at what went wrong, and thankfully, what went right. We also welcome Phantoms defenseman JT Veney to the show!

title: Learning Moments w/ Kelsey Moreton & Chase Powell
description: The Phantoms end their road trip with a rough weekend in Michigan, but flush it and forget it. The hope opener is upon us! Phantoms Sr. Vice President Kelsey Moreton and Promotions Director Chase Powell hop on to fill us in on what we have to look forward to this weekend!

title: What Kind Of Season Is This? w/ Ryan Rucinski
description: The magic keeps on rolling! The Phantoms are 4-0 for the second time in team history! We'll look back on the weekend in Michigan and talk about how it all went down. We also welcome new Phantoms Team Captain Ryan Rucinski back to the show!

title: Season 8 Premiere w/ Matt Lipcsak
description: We are back for another year of Phantoms Hockey! To kick it off, we're looking back at a historic Fall Classic for the boys. And we get into Round 2 of our All-Time Phantoms Fantasy Draft where we are joined by Voice of the Phantoms and Friend of the Show, Matt Lipcsak!

title: Episode 200 w/ Andrew Goldman
description: We're back to shake off the cobwebs and get ready for another season of Phantoms hockey! We'll recap the summer break, as well as take a peek at the upcoming start to the season. We also welcome back Phantoms Team President Andrew Goldman to help us celebrate our 200th Episode!

title: 2025 Main Camp: Part 8 - Matt Lipcsak, Lynn Seekford & Donnie Eaton
description: We've come down to the end of the Phantoms 2025 Main Camp Recap! In Part 8, we welcome back press box besties Matt Lipcsak & Lynn Seekford. And (finally!) we've got the longtime Phantoms bus driver who quite frankly was the star of this episode, Donnie Eaton! Thanks for listening along, and we'll catch you all again in September!

title: 2025 Main Camp: Part 7 - Carter Murphy & Luca Jarvis
description: Welcome to Part 7 of the Phantoms 2025 Main Camp Recap. This is our conversation with defenseman Carter Murphy and forward Luca Jarvis. Both are well spoken young men, even after taking a puck to the mouth! Hope you enjoy!

title: 2025 Main Camp: Part 6 - Brecken Smith & Evan Jardine
description: This is Part 6 of the Phantoms 2025 Main Camp Recap! In this interview, we welcome back returners Brecken Smith & Evan Jardine. We get into the deep issues, like camp color schemes and fighting with face cages! Check it out!

title: 2025 Main Camp: Part 5 - Robbie Murden & Adam Jonak
description: This is Part 5 of the Phantoms Main Camp Recap! On deck, we welcome back Friend of the Show, Assistant GM Robbie Murden, and for the 1st time, we welcome Assistant GM and Director of European Scouting Adam Jonak! Robbie and Adam take us through some of this year's Phase II picks. Check it out!

title: 2025 Main Camp: Part 4 - Jack Hextall & Logan Anderson w/ Cal Huston
description: This is Part 4 of the 2025 Phantoms Main Camp Recap! We welcome last year's and this year's Tenders, Jack Hextall & Logan Anderson! Plus, a very special guest stopped by the room to help us introduce Jack & Logan!

title: 2025 Main Camp: Part 3 - Ryan Kosecki, Jeff Cox & Timmy Parkos
description: Welcome to Part 3 of the Youngstown Phantoms Main Camp Recap. In this, we welcome a few experts from the Phase I Draft in Co-GM Ryan Kosecki and Assistant GMs Jeff Cox & Timmy Parkos. Minnesota!

title: 2025 Main Camp: Part 2 - Malachi McKinnon & Kade Stengrim
description: This is Part 2 of the 2025 Main Camp Recap! In this episode, we welcome newcomer Malachi McKinnon, and our final interview with the now Canada-bound Kade Stengrim. Nothing but love for Kade here, though!

title: 2025 Main Camp: Part 1 - Ryan Ward & Jason Deskins
description: It's that time of year! After another great weekend at Phantoms Main Camp, we got to sit down for 8 more awesome interviews with players and staff! Let's kick it off with Part 1 as we welcome Head Coach Ryan Ward and Co-GM Jason Deskins!

title: Gritty City Full Track
description: As an end-of-the-season bonus, here is the full version of "Gritty City", the Official Theme Song of the Dump & Chase Podcast that debuted just a few weeks ago!

title: That's All, Folks! (Season 7 Finale)
description: It's time to heal, and to look ahead. On the Season 7 Finale, we look back at a lot of the good we got out of this season, and celebrate this incredible Phantoms team. We also look ahead to our future amidst a busy off season. Thanks for joining us once again on this crazy ride!

title: 2025 Playoffs - Part 1
description: Playoffs Baby!!! Round 1 has concluded, and the Muskegon Lumberjacks are coming to Youngstown as the Phantoms kick off the 2025 playoffs in Round 2. We'll haphazardly look back on Round 1, and preview this weekend's games at the Covelli Centre!

title: #1 And We're Not Done w/ Ryan Ward
description: To the victors go the spoils, and Eastern Conference Regular Season Champions and a 1st Round bye is a good start for the Phantoms! We look back on how the team wrapped up the East, and welcome back Phantoms Head Coach Ryan Ward for an extended interview!

title: Cap'n Crunch w/ Coleson Hanrahan
description: For the 1st time in show history, we can say the 1ST PLACE Phantoms picked up 5 out of 6 points last weekend, and now our focus is towards the final weekend of the regular season. We also welcome back the newly minted Friend of the Show, Coleson Hanrahan, plus a bonus interview with Ohio State's own Nathan Lewis!

title: Thy Cup Runneth Empty w/ Luke Osburn
description: The Phantoms swept Fargo, a 1st round bye is still within reach, and Justin is back for another episode! We'll look back on a great weekend in Youngstown and welcome back to the show, defenseman and assistant captain, Luke Osburn!

title: More Like A Slight Drizzle w/ Conner de Haro
description: The Phantoms are back in Youngstown after getting 3 out of 4 wins on a long Western Conference swing. We welcome Assistant Captain Conner de Haro back to the show, and for the first time ever, we recommend that you stick around to the very end of this episode!

title: Punching Tickets w/ Jason Deskins
description: In this extended episode, we welcome Phantoms Co-General Manager Jason Deskins back to the show to discuss trades, the draft, and the future of Junior hockey. We also break down the weekend in South Dakota and look ahead to the Phantoms trip to Nebraska.

title: And In Goal... w/ Melvin Strahl
description: The Phantoms finished out an 8 game homestand, going 6-2 and jumping to 2nd in the East. We'll look back at a 3 game series with Madison, and finally welcome goaltender Melvin Strahl to the show!

title: Entering The Home Stretch w/ Brandon Gotkin
description: One half of the Phantoms 6 games in 9 days nightmare has passed, and the second half will be equally, if not more challenging. We're here to break it all down, as well as answer your pressing questions. (Apologies to Luke Osburn) We also welcome back to the show, Phantoms Associate Head Coach Brandon Gotkin!

title: Let The Phans Eat w/ Michael Punzalan
description: The Phantoms swept their weekend series with Muskegon, and several Jacks got Jack'd! We're here to recap these games blow by blow, and we welcome STH Michael Punzalan to the show and get to know more about one of the Phantoms biggest phans!

title: Cry Us A River w/ Luke Santilli
description: The Phantoms got the weekend sweep of the Steel, and with Chicago tradition, the river of tears was dyed green. 2 of the 3 of us were sick for this episode, try to guess which ones! We also welcome Luke Santilli to the show for the first time!

title: Iowa, We Hardly Knew Ya w/ Ryan Rucinski
description: The Phantoms final regular season trip to Iowa ends in a split weekend, and we're here to celebra...talk about it. We welcome forward Ryan Rucinski back to the show, and get a surprise guest during the interview!

title: You're Talking About Trades? w/ Justin Kerr
description: The Phantoms completed a 2 weekend, 4 game sweep of the NTDP, and the roster is about to look a little different. Plus, we welcome forward Justin Kerr to the show!

title: Release the Fuzz! w/ Jack Willson
description: The Phantoms got a weekend sweep of the U18s, and the fur was flying! In this episode, we chat with the scorer of the teddy bear goal, defenseman Jack Willson!

title: Hit The Sleds w/ Jamison Sluys, Stephen Olesky, & Anna Airhart
description: The Phantoms come home from Michigan with 4 points and return to Covelli for two games with Dubuque and the annual Charity Sled Game! We welcome Phantoms forward Jamison Sluys, Stephen Olesky from Adaptive Sports Ohio, and Anna Airhart from the Youngstown Boom Sled Hockey Team!

title: The 'Stache Awakens w/ Chase Pietila
description: We said we're going big in 2025, and what better way to kick it off than to welcome back Phantoms legend, Michigan Tech Huskies Assistant Captain and Penguins draft pick Chase Pietila!

title: 2024 Holiday Special w/ Colin Winn
description: Gather 'round the fireplace (video that you casted from YouTube to your TV) and kick back for this year's Holiday Special! It's an honor to welcome back to the show, Youngstown's adopted son and Dump & Chase Legend, Colin Winn!

title: Coaches & Cornstalks w/ Ryan Ward
description: The Phantoms got goals in their stockings and 4 points for the sleigh ride home from Green Bay. We'll look back on a 3 game weekend, and welcome an extended visit from Phantoms Head Coach Ryan Ward!

title: Let's Start Over w/ Michael Mesic
description: The Phantoms win streak is no more despite a valiant effort by a patchwork lineup. We'll look back on the weekend that was, and welcome forward Michael Mesic to the show!

title: Next Man Up w/ Kazimier Sobieski
description: The Phantoms win streak is up to 9! But, the team faces their toughest stretch of games this season in the coming month. We'll break down where the Phantoms stand, and welcome defenseman Kazimier Sobieski to the show!

title: Lucky Number Seven w/ Kade Stengrim
description: The Phantoms are the proud owners of a 7 game win streak, and we're back to celebrate! Plus, we have a Phan Q&A! And we welcome forward Kade Stengrim to the show!

title: A Perfect Ten w/ Landan Resendes
description: The Phantoms are riding a 5 game winning streak after a 3 game weekend sweep, and we're here to enjoy it! Also, we welcome forward Landan Resendes to the show!

title: Good Eatin' w/ Carter Murphy
description: The shot buffet was out, and 12 goals on the menu! The Phantoms get the weekend sweep of the Steel! And to celebrate, we welcome defenseman Carter Murphy to the show!

title: In This Town, We Call Home w/ Louie Wehmann
description: Costumes, candy, and scary-ish movies. It's our Halloween episode, packed with extra "Protein" as we welcome to the show for the first time, Phantoms forward Louie Wehmann!

title: Welcome Home, Kid w/ Cal Huston
description: A not so great weekend for the Phantoms, but there were a few bright spots. The brightest of those was this week's guest, Cal Huston! Cal fills us in on everything that surrounded his Phantoms Covelli debut!

title: Be It Ever So Humble w/ Matt Lipcsak & Kelsey Moreton
description: The Phantoms are coming home to Covelli, and we decided to share our joy with great friends! We welcome Matt Lipcsak & Kelsey Moreton back to the show, and this was a fun one to record!

title: A Bit Draft-y In Here
description: The Phantoms are back from a trip to Iowa, and now get a week of R&R. So to fill the void, we held our first ever Phantoms All-Time Phantasy Draft. And afterwards, we still kind of like each other.

title: Please Refrain From Throwing Objects w/ Mikey Burchill
description: The Phantoms split the split weekend, and we're back to break it all down, including some help from Assistant Captain Mikey Burchill!

title: Season 7 Premiere w/ Coleson Hanrahan
description: It's time for another trip around the USHL sun! We're back with the Season 7 Premiere! We'll break down the Fall Classic, as well as welcome back Team Captain, Coleson Hanrahan!

title: Shaking Off The Rust - Preseason Edition w/ Andrew Goldman
description: It's time to shake off the summer rust and get in podcast shape! We're back with our preseason episode, but we didn't take this show lightly as we welcome back Phantoms Team President Andrew Goldman!

title: 2024 Main Camp: Part 10 - Coleson Hanrahan & Hunter Ramos
description: This is the Finale of the 2024 Main Camp Recap Series! In Part 10, we wrap up this journey, and talk with Phantoms defenseman Coleson Hanrahan and speedy forward Hunter Ramos! Thanks for listening along!

title: 2024 Main Camp: Part 9 - Brecken Smith & Luke Osburn
description: Welcome to Part 9 of the 2024 Main Camp Recap! In this episode, we welcome returning forward Brecken Smith and Buffalo Sabres draft pick, defenseman Luke Osburn!

title: 2024 Main Camp: Part 8 - Brandon Gotkin & Andy Contois
description: Welcome to Part 8! In this episode, we welcome back Assistant Coach Brandon Gotkin, and since this interview was recorded, the newest member of the Northern Michigan coaching staff, Andy Contois!

title: 2024 Main Camp: Part 7 - Owen Lepak & Cal Huston
description: We're into the home stretch with Part 7! In this episode, we welcome the NAHL All-East Rookie of the Year Owen Lepak, and welcome back Youngstown native Cal Huston to the show!

title: 2024 Main Camp: Part 6 - Tim Parkos & Ryan Kosecki
description: We're up to Part 6! In this episode, we welcome Phantoms Co-General Manager Ryan Kosecki and Assistant GM and Director of Scouting Tim Parkos to talk about the Phantoms Phase II Draft!

title: 2024 Main Camp: Part 5 - Eric Frossard & Beckham Edwards
description: We've hit the halfway point! In Part 5, we welcome a pair of London, Ontario natives, Phantoms tender Beckham Edwards and Phase I 2nd Round pick Eric Frossard! 5 down, 5 to go!

title: 2024 Main Camp: Part 4 - Jason Deskins, Jeff Cox & Robbie Murden
description: It's time for Part 4 of the 2024 Phantoms Main Camp Recap. We are joined by Co-General Manager Jason Deskins, and Assistant GMs Jeff Cox & Robbie Murden. Always a fun time getting these guys together!

title: 2024 Main Camp: Part 3 - Jack Hextall & Evan Jardine
description: It's time for Part 3! Here, we chat with Phantoms Tender Jack Hextall, and someone who made the most of his limited time with Youngstown last season, Evan Jardine!

title: 2024 Main Camp: Part 2 - Aiden Wright & Conner de Haro
description: Let's keep the train rolling! In Part 2, we welcome a couple of returning Phantoms and long time friends from North Carolina in Aiden Wright and Conner de Haro!

title: 2024 Main Camp: Part 1 - Matt Lipcsak & Ryan Ward
description: It's that time of year! The Dump & Chase Podcast 2024 Main Camp Recap kicks off with Part 1! We took two of our favorites in Voice of the Phantoms Matt Lipcsak, and Phantoms Head Coach Ryan Ward!

title: Thank You (Season 6 Finale)
description: Well, the Phantoms season is over, and so is Season 6 of the podcast. We have a lot to say, so buckle up! Thank you to all of you who listen to and support the show! We can't wait for Season 7 to start!

title: Wright And Wrong
description: The Phantoms reclaimed home ice advantage after splitting Games 1 & 2 in Dubuque. While Dan is on assignment, Sam and Justin get a throwback episode to break down what was, and look ahead to what could be.

title: Tip Of The Cap (Rd. 2 Preview) w/ Brandon Gotkin
description: The Phantoms came back from a 0-1 deficit to oust Madison and move on to Round 2! Unlike Justin's tongue piercing passing through his system, we'll break down Round 1 and welcome Assistant Coach Brandon Gotkin back to the show!

title: Playoffs, Baby! w/ Amber Martinelli
description: The regular season is over, and the playoffs are here! We'll look back at the Phantoms sweep of the U17s, and look ahead to a first round matchup with Madison. And, we finally welcome Head Athletic Trainer Amber Martinelli to the show!

title: A Fighting Chance w/ Coleson Hanrahan
description: The Phantoms took 5 out of 6 points from Green Bay, and have a few scenarios for playoff seeding coming into the last weekend of the season. We'll go through all of them, as well as welcome #47 Coleson Hanrahan to the show!

title: Puke And Rally w/ Mikey Burchill
description: From the outhouse to the penthouse, this past weekend for the Phantoms had it all. We'll attempt to break down where it went right and wrong. We also welcome forward Mikey Burchill back to the show!

title: Florida Man Talks Hockey w/ Jacob Fowler
description: We're back after a week off to catch up on the Phantoms final road trip of the regular season and... ah screw it, JACOB FOWLER IS BACK ON THE SHOW!

title: Season 6 Episode 23 Announcement
He's Baaaaack! w/ Nathan Lewis
description: The Phantoms picked up 3 out of 6 points this past weekend, and line brawls were on the menu. The biggest story of the weekend was the debut of Nathan Lewis, and we sat down with him to get his take on the weekend!

title: Help Is On The Way w/ Aiden Wright
description: The Phantoms started the weekend with the School Day Game and a packed house. That would be the high point of the weekend. We'll look back at a couple tough losses, and welcome goaltender Aiden Wright to the show!

title: Oh Captain, My Capt...Duck! w/ Andrew Strathmann
description: A great weekend for the Phantoms leads to yet another long, quiet bus ride back to Chicago for the Steel. We'll look back on how it all went down, as well as welcome Andrew Strathmann back to the show!

title: Good-er Vibrations w/ Steven Smith
description: The Phantoms picked up 3 out of 6 points this past weekend, and we're here to break down a wacky-ish weekend. We also welcome back Phantoms Head Equipment Manager Steven Smith, aka Smitty!

title: The Truth Shall Set You Free
description: Sirens are blaring. Dogs and cats, living together. Mass hysteria. That's right, the Phantoms made a trade. We'll recap the boy's rough weekend in Muskegon, and lay out some truths that some people need to hear.

title: It Starts In Youngstown w/ Cal Huston
description: We're back after a wild and crazy weekend with the Phantoms winning 2 out of 3, and we'll attempt to make sense of the madness. Plus, we welcome Youngstown native Cal Huston back to the show!

title: Brooms and Sleds w/ Ryan Rucinski
description: The Phantoms have rediscovered their winning ways, and learned that sled hockey players show no mercy. We'll recap a fun weekend of hockey, and welcome forward Adam Pietila..sorry...Ryan Rucinski to the show!

title: The Return of Ryan Ward
description: This week, we welcome back Head Coach Ryan Ward! Following Ryan, we're joined by Steve Olesky from Adaptive Sports Ohio to talk about the Sled Hockey Charity game this Sunday at Covelli!

title: Four  Days In Iowa w/ Miles Gunty
description: Mother Nature gave the Phantoms a shortened weekend as far as games, but not for travel. We'll take a look at the lone game played, and welcome forward Miles Gunty back to the show!

title: Short-Term Memory w/ Charlie Cerrato
description: The Phantoms are now on a 4 game skid, but folks, we've seen a lot worse. We'll make sense of this past weekend with Omaha, and look ahead to the team's field trip to Iowa. Plus, we sit down with Forward Charlie Cerrato!

title: Abandon Ship (Or, Not) w/ Matt Lipcsak
description: We're back after the holidays with new logos, new merch, and a sense of calm after a rough weekend in Michigan for the Phantoms. We break down the past weekend, and welcome Voice of the Phantoms Matt Lipcsak back to the show!

title: Brooms For Christmas w/ Lynn Seekford
description: In our final full episode of 2023, we look back at the depth chart masterclass the Phantoms put on this past weekend. We also welcome the Phantoms official scorekeeper Lynn Seekford to the show! Happy Holidays everyone!

title: Next Man Up w/ Colin Winn
description: We're back with only half as much coughing as last week. The Phantoms split their weekend with Cedar Rapids, and we're going to look at the how and why. And in a new edition of Phantom Files, we welcome back goaltender Colin Winn!

title: Let's Run It Up The Flagpole w/ John Tomko
description: We take a week off, and Sam catches Covid for the 2nd time to celebrate. Beyond that, we talk about the Phantoms split weekend in New York, introduce our new segment "Phantom Files", and welcome special guest, billet John Tomko!

title: Thanksgiving Special: Our Hockey Stories
description: In this special holiday episode, the three of us sat down to discuss holiday traditions, as well as what our own hockey origin stories are. Never forget that we are most thankful for all of you, and a Happy Thanksgiving to everyone!

title: Let's Be Mature About This
description: An older, wiser podcast crew is back to break down the Phantoms split weekend in Iowa. No shoddy camera work here, except for Dan. Must of been contagious.

title: Sometimes, You Just Gotta Find A Way
description: The Phantoms swept their weekend series with Tri-City, and Colin Winn is now our spirit animal! Also, listener discretion is advised during 4 Points. Things got weird fast. Seriously, it's not something you want to explain to your kids.

title: We Ourselves Are Strange And Unusual
description: The Phantoms take 5 out of 6 points in a 3 game weekend, and we're back to break it all down. We add a little Halloween flair to the show, and Justin uses the word "Spooktacular". Not even kidding.

title: Hey Kids, Winning Is Fun!
description: The Phantoms completed a 4 point weekend, and are looking to pick up 6 more in 3 homes games this weekend. We'll look back a game and a half of great hockey, and look ahead to another West opponent coming to town!

title: Win? Check! Winn? Cross-Check!
description: The Phantoms split their weekend series in Lincoln, and we're back to break it all down! We're not going to lie, things got a little weird on this episode. Like, beyond our usual weird.

title: Captain's Choice
description: Phantoms Media Day, a home weekend sweep, and some old friends stop by for this packed episode! We welcome back the guys from the Thunderstruck Podcast to chat about the Phantoms 1st trip to Lincoln since 2019, as well as break down a two win weekend!

title: He Shoots! He Scores!
description: We're back for another week as the Phantoms put on a BANNER performance in thumping the NTDP U17s! In this episode, we'll cover everything between entering the parking lot and leaving the parking lot!

title: Let's Run It Back (Season 6 Premiere)
description: Season 6 of the Dump & Chase Podcast starts now! Sam, Justin, and "Da New Guy" Dan break down the Phantoms trip to the Fall Classic in Cranberry, and look ahead to the home opener and banner raising. With special guest Anna Hughes!

title: Preseason Roster Edition
description: This is our final offseason/preseason episode before the Season 6 Premiere! Join Sam, Justin, and Dan as they give their takes on the Phantoms 30 man preseason roster!

title: Round 4: Head Coach Ryan Ward
description: You asked, we answered! Phantoms Head Coach Ryan Ward returns to the show to discuss last season, main camp, and what his ideas for starting a title defense are.

title: Massive Podcast News (Not Clickbait)
description: After 4+ years, it's time to shake things up. This short episode features one of the biggest announcements we've ever made, as well as Justin's apathy towards tornado warnings!

title: The Summer So Far
description: We're back with a summer recap...of sorts. We'll discuss some of the summer's biggest stories about the USHL, the Phantoms, and the upcoming 23-24 season schedule. Hockey is right around the corner!

title: 2023 Main Camp Recap: Part 8 - Miles Gunty & Andrew Goldman
description: This is Part 8 of our Phantoms Main Camp Interview Series. We finish this off with Cup Finals legend Miles Gunty, and the 2023 USHL Executive of the Year, Andrew Goldman!

title: 2023 Main Camp: Part 7 - Matt Lipcsak
description: Welcome to Part 7 of our Phantoms Main Camp interview series. In this episode, from high atop of the mountain, is Friend of the Show and Voice of the Phantoms Matt Lipcsak!

title: 2023 Main Camp: Part 6 - Sascha Boumedienne & Zachary Morin
description: This is Part 6 of our Youngstown Phantoms Main Camp interview series. In this episode, we welcome both of the Phantoms tenders for this upcoming season, Sascha Boumedienne and Zach Morin!

title: 2023 Main Camp: Part 5 - Asst. GMs Jeff Cox, Tim Parkos, & Robbie Murden
description: This is Past 5 of our Phantoms 2023 Main Camp series. We welcome Assistant General Managers Jeff Cox, Tim Parkos, and Robbie Murden.

title: 2023 Main Camp: Part 4 - Nathan Lewis & Mikey Burchill
description: In Part 4 of this series, we welcome the newest members of the Youngstown Phantoms, Nathan Lewis (Madison) and Mikey Burchill (Dubuque)

title: 2023 Main Camp: Part 3 - Kelsey Moreton, Maddy Beight, & Tyrell Rodgers
description: In Part 3 of our Main Camp series, we welcome Kelsey Moreton, Maddy Beight, and Tyrell Rodgers to the show! The gang gets into what it took to put Game 3 of the Finals together, and what this season was like for them overall.

title: 2023 Main Camp: Part 2 - Colin Winn & Tory Pitner
description: In Part 2 of this eight part series, we welcome goaltender Colin Winn and defensemen Tory Pitner to the show. The boys talked about the quick turnaround from last season, starting their 2nd season with the Phantoms, and Colin's practice routine!

title: 2023 Main Camp: Part 1 - Steven Smith & Sean Novotny
description: This is Part 1 of an eight part series covering our interviews from the 2023 Youngstown Phantoms Main Camp! A new interview will drop every 3 days. We kick off this series with the return of Equipment Manager Steven Smith, and "The Godfather" Sean Novotny!

title: Clark Cup Champions...Forever
description: This is the episode we have waited over 4 years to put out! The Phantoms are the 2023 Clark Cup Champions! This extended Season 5 Finale has recaps of Game 3 and of the Rally, interviews, a look back at the season, and a look ahead to the future. Thanks for listening!

title: One Win To Rule Them All
description: The Youngstown Phantoms are one win away from glory, and we're here for it. We'll look back on a great weekend in Fargo, and look ahead to what could be the greatest weekend in Phantoms history!

title: Clark! Cup! Finals!
description: The Phantoms are the Eastern Conference Champions, and move on to the Clark Cup Finals! We'll look back at games 3 & 4 against Chicago, and look ahead to Games 1 & 2 vs the Fargo Force. We also welcome Gene Cotter from the Thunderstruck Podcast to break down Fargo!

title: To Absent Friends...
description: This episode is dedicated to the life and memory of our dear friend and 222 Crew Member, Kevin Carney. We break down the Phantoms 2 games in Chicago to start the Eastern Conference Finals, and look ahead to Games 3 & 4 at the Covelli Centre.

title: Phantoms Watch Parties w/ Sr. VP Kelsey Moreton
description: In this bonus release, Phantoms Sr. Vice President Kelsey Moreton stops by to talk about the Phantoms Watch Parties taking place at Waypoint 4108 @ Kensington Golf Club and Grill in Canfield this Friday & Saturday! Food, drinks, fans! Make your plans now!

title: Pressure Is A Privilege
description: The Phantoms took care of business in the 2nd Round, and now are gearing up for the biggest USHL Playoff matchup in recent history! We'll break down the 2nd Round Sweep, and look ahead to the EC Finals with the Chicago Steel! Plus hear from Chase Pietila!

title: Round 2: Fight!
description: We're back for the 2nd episode this week. Round 1 of the USHL Playoffs is over, and Round 2 is upon us! We'll look back at the results this past week, and break down what we have coming up in the 2nd Round! Plus comments from Head Coach Ryan Ward!

title: Two Sweet!
description: The Phantoms did what they needed to do and locked up the #2 Seed. In this episode, we'll look back on the weekend sweep of the U17s, name the 3 Stars of the Season, and have a post game chat with goaltender Jacob Fowler, as well as preview Round 1!

title: It All Comes Down To This
description: This is the final week of the regular season for the Phantoms. Will they end up in 3rd place and quickly start the payoffs on Monday, or take 2nd and skip the 1st round? That's what we'll break down this week! We also welcome Sales Executive Maddie Beight to the show!

title: The Refs Finally Broke Sam
